title: Machine
description: One machine in depth: CPU, memory, every disk's free space and forecast, I/O, network and hardware.

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description: Full in: the last 6 hours' trend projected forward. 'not filling' means over a year away, or shrinking.

targets.expr: max by (mountpoint, fstype, device) (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{host="$host", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|devtmpfs|squashfs|overlay|nsfs|fuse.*", mountpoint!~"/run.*"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{host="$host", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|devtmpfs|squashfs|overlay|nsfs|fuse.*", mountpoint!~"/run.*"})

max by (mountpoint, fstype, device) (clamp_max(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{host="$host", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|devtmpfs|squashfs|overlay|nsfs|fuse.*", mountpoint!~"/run.*"} / clamp_min(-deriv(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{host="$host", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|devtmpfs|squashfs|overlay|nsfs|fuse.*", mountpoint!~"/run.*"}[6h]), 1e-9) / 86400, 366))

max by (mountpoint, fstype, device) (1 - node_filesystem_files_free{host="$host", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|devtmpfs|squashfs|overlay|nsfs|fuse.*", mountpoint!~"/run.*"} / node_filesystem_files{host="$host", fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|devtmpfs|squashfs|overlay|nsfs|fuse.*", mountpoint!~"/run.*"})

panels.title: CPU frequency
panels.description: Held below maximum while idle; pinned below it under load means throttling.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Cache is given back on demand, so 'used' is what matters.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Reads above the line, writes below.

panels.title: Busy time
panels.description: Share of time the device had I/O in flight.

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Received above the line, sent below.

panels.title: Pi power and throttling
panels.description: Under-voltage, frequency capping and thermal throttling, as the firmware reports them.
